A vulnerability has been found in a2ui-project a2ui up to 0.10.7. Affected by this vulnerability is the function httpx.get of the file agent_sdks/python/a2ui_agent/src/a2ui/extensions/file_resolve/file_resolver.py of the component FileResolver. The manipulation leads to server-side request forgery.
